title: EditTimeline
description: Complete video editing timeline with tracks, markers, items, and metadata

projectId.description: Project identifier this timeline belongs to

tracks.description: List of tracks in this timeline

markers.description: List of markers in this timeline

inOut.description: Optional in/out point range for playback

seed.description: Optional seed data for timeline generation

colorGroups.description: P7: clips graded together; a clip is in at most one group

sequences.description: P8: the nested timelines compound clips play; a sequence never contains itself, nesting depth at most 4

buses.description: P8: the submix buses tracks route to through busId; a bus with no outputBusId feeds the master

aspectPolicy.description: How to handle aspect ratio mismatches

locked.description: Whether the track is locked for editing

enabled.description: Whether the track is enabled in output

mute.description: Whether the track is muted (audio tracks)

solo.description: Whether only this track should play (audio tracks)

gainDb.description: P5: the track fader in dB — value is the static level, keys an automation envelope over timeline frames; null is unity

pan.description: P5: stereo balance, -1 hard left .. 1 hard right; 0 (the default) is centre

eq.description: P5: the track equaliser; null is flat

dynamics.description: P8: the track's dynamics section; null is none

denoise.description: P8: the track's denoiser; null is none

leveler.description: P8: the track's leveler; null is none

items.description: Clips and elements on this track

recordIn.description: Start position on the record (output) clock in frames

recordOut.description: End position on the record (output) clock in frames (exclusive)

provenance.description: How this item was created (agent decision, import, manual edit)

recordIn.description: Start position on the record (output) clock in frames

recordOut.description: End position on the record (output) clock in frames (exclusive)

assetRef.description: Reference to the source media asset (resolvable against the owning project)

sourceIn.description: Offset into the source asset in frames

gainDb.description: Clip gain in dB as a keyframed 'double': 'value' is the static clip gain, 'keys' an optional time-varying gain envelope that overrides it

transform.description: P5: position/scale/rotation/opacity, each optionally keyframed; null is the identity

crop.description: P5: a static crop as fractions of the source picture; null crops nothing

sourceRotation.description: An extra clockwise quarter turn of the source picture, applied before crop and fit; null/0 is the identity

reverse.description: P5: play the source backwards (sourceIn stays the lowest source frame touched); bounded by MaxReverseFrames

hold.description: P5: freeze frame — every frame shows source frame sourceIn and the clip is silent; exclusive with reverse

fadeInFrames.description: P5: picture and sound fade in over this many frames from recordIn

fadeOutFrames.description: P5: picture and sound fade out over this many frames before recordOut

grade.description: P7: the clip's own grade stack, applied after its colour group's; null is no grade

mask.description: P7: a shape mask (no kind = rect) or a segmentation mask (kind 'segmentation') on the picture; null shows the whole picture

keyer.description: P7: a chroma keyer; null keys nothing

effects.description: P7: effects from the closed catalogue, applied in order after the grade

regionEffects.description: Prompted region effects applied to the object a segmentation mask follows, in order; at most 4

stabilize.description: P7: stabilise the picture at render time (two-pass vidstab)

reframe.description: P7: crop the source to the canvas aspect around a subject point; null keeps the aspect policy's fit

retimeQuality.description: P7: how a slowed clip makes its frames — duplicated, or motion-interpolated

cornerPin.description: P7: a manual corner pin of the whole picture onto the canvas, corners in canvas fractions

channelMap.description: P8: how the source's channels reach the stereo mix; stereo (the default) passes them as they are

linkId.description: R08.1: clips sharing a link id form a link group (a video clip and its camera-audio companion); null is not linked

inputProfile.description: P3: the camera log profile the source was shot in (CameraProfiles.Ids); null or absent is a display-space source

blendMode.description: L5: how the picture combines with what is below it (a video-track clip); null or absent is normal alpha-over

template.description: P7: a title template from the closed catalogue; null is the plain centred title

position.description: R09.6/R10.5: where the text sits on a 3x3 pad; null is the default placement (caption bottom centre, title centred)

transform.description: L6: free move/scale/rotate/opacity of the title around its own anchor; null keeps the template/position placement

generatorType.description: Type of generated content (e.g., bars, noise, color)

anyOf.description: Configuration specific to the generator type

quad.description: Tracked corner-pin quad as a keyframed 'QuadCorners' value

matte.description: P7: the matte parameters the insert is keyed with before it is pinned; null is an opaque insert

look.description: R09.6: the caption burn-in look from the closed catalogue; null is clean

position.description: R09.6/R10.5: where the text sits on a 3x3 pad; null is the default placement (caption bottom centre, title centred)

transitionType.description: Type of transition (e.g., dissolve, fade, wipe)

sequenceId.description: The sequence this clip plays; must exist in the document's sequences

sourceIn.description: Offset into the sequence, in frames

CompoundClip.description: P8: a compound clip - plays a nested sequence from sourceIn for its span; flattened for rendering and preview

activeAngleId.description: The angle playing from recordIn until the first cut

cuts.description: Angle switches in strictly increasing frame order, each strictly inside the span

sourceIn.description: Offset into the synchronised multicam source, in frames

gainDb.description: Clip gain in dB for the active angle's audio

audioSource.description: R08.5: which audio the clip plays: null or "program" follows the active angle, "none" is silent, an angle id plays that angle throughout

MulticamClip.description: P8: a multicam clip - synchronised angles of one moment, one playing at a time; flattened into media clips for rendering and preview

grade.description: P7: the grade applied to every layer composited below this clip for its span

effects.description: P7: effects from the closed catalogue, applied after the grade

AdjustmentClip.description: P7: an adjustment clip - a grade and effects applied to everything composited below it for its span

EditRange.description: A range with in and out points

executionId.description: The workflow execution ID that generated this timeline

version.description: The version of the timeline manifest

ClipTransform.description: P5: a media clip's picture transform. Every channel is a Keyframed number; a null channel is its identity (position 0, scale 1, rotation 0, opacity 1).

positionX.description: Horizontal offset of the clip centre from the canvas centre, as a fraction of the canvas width; range [-2, 2]

positionY.description: Vertical offset as a fraction of the canvas height, positive = down; range [-2, 2]

scale.description: Uniform scale relative to the fitted size; range (0, 8]

rotation.description: Rotation about the clip centre in degrees, positive = clockwise; range [-360, 360]

scaleY.description: L6: vertical scale, range (0, 8]; absent means the same as scale (uniform); when present, scale is the horizontal scale

ClipCrop.description: P5: a static crop of the source picture, each edge a fraction in [0, 1); left+right and top+bottom each stay below 1.

TrackEq.description: P5: a track equaliser — optional low cut, optional high cut, up to four parametric bands.

lowCutHz.description: High-pass corner frequency in Hz, or null for none

highCutHz.description: Low-pass corner frequency in Hz, or null for none

interp.description: Interpolation method to the next keyframe

stepResultId.description: Optional workflow step result that generated this

rationale.description: Optional explanation of why this was chosen/created

editedByUser.description: Whether the user has manually edited this item

agentName.description: Optional agent display name (a v1 seed fills this); ids are filled by v2-native paths

providerName.description: Optional inference provider display name (a v1 seed fills this); ids are filled by v2-native paths

stepResultId.description: Reference to a workflow step result

QuadCorners.description: Four corner points of a (possibly non-planar) quad

GradeWheel.description: P7: one colour wheel - a per-channel offset plus a master, each in [-1, 1], 0 = no change

GradePrimaries.description: P7: the primaries of one grade node; every field defaults to its identity

CurvePoint.description: P7: a point of a tone curve, both coordinates in [0, 1]

GradeCurves.description: P7: a master (luma) curve and one per channel, each at most 16 points with strictly increasing x; null/empty is the identity

GradeLut.description: P7: a .cube project file applied as a 3D LUT, blended toward identity by intensity

GradeNode.description: P7: one correction of a grade stack - primaries, curves and/or a LUT, individually bypassable

qualifier.description: P9: an HSL qualifier confining the correction

window.description: P9: a (tracked) power window confining the correction

GradeQualifier.description: P9: an HSL secondary selection - hue within hueWidth degrees of hueCenter, saturation and lightness bands, softness, invert

GradeWindow.description: P9: a power window - a shape, optionally tracked by keyframed offsets in canvas fractions

GradeStack.description: P7: the ordered corrections of a clip, a colour group or an adjustment clip; enabled=false bypasses the whole stack

ColorGroup.description: P7: clips graded together; the group's stack is applied before each member's own

lookGroupId.description: The analysis look group (k{n}) the group was pre-populated from

ShapeMask.description: P7: a rectangle or ellipse mask in canvas fractions with a feathered edge; or, with kind 'segmentation' (a clip mask only), the union of tracks g{n} of a same-project VideoAnalyze result: only kind, analysisStepResultId, trackIds, invert and featherPx apply

analysisStepResultId.description: segmentation: the VideoAnalyze step result (same project) whose SegmentationTracks are named

trackIds.description: segmentation: the track ids (g{n}) whose union is the matte

featherPx.description: segmentation: the edge feather in pixels

ChromaKeyer.description: P7: a chroma keyer - key colour #RRGGBB, colorkey similarity (0, 1] and blend [0, 1], spill suppression [0, 1]

ClipEffect.description: P7: one effect of the closed catalogue with an amount in [0, 1]; blur alone ranges to [0, 2] (sigma = amount x 20)

RegionClipEffect.description: One region effect of a clip: applied inside (or, with the mask invert flag, outside) the object a segmentation mask follows; strength in [0, 1]

mask.description: Must be kind 'segmentation' (validated), with invert and featherPx

ReframeTarget.description: P7: the subject point (canvas fractions) an auto-reframe crops around

EditSequence.description: P8: a nested timeline a compound clip plays - its own tracks in sequence-local frames

MulticamAngle.description: P8: one angle of a multicam clip; offsetFrames is the angle's source frame at multicam-source frame 0

inputProfile.description: P3: the camera log profile the angle's source was shot in (CameraProfiles.Ids), carried onto every flattened run; null or absent is a display-space source

MulticamCut.description: P8: an angle switch at a record frame inside the clip's span

AudioCompressor.description: P8: a compressor - threshold dBFS [-60, 0], ratio [1, 20], attack/release ms [1, 2000], make-up dB [0, 24]

AudioLimiter.description: P8: a brick-wall limiter at a ceiling in dBFS [-24, 0]

AudioGate.description: P8: a noise gate - threshold dBFS [-90, 0], ratio [1, 20], attack/release ms [1, 2000]

AudioDeesser.description: P8: a de-esser at an intensity in [0, 1]

AudioDynamics.description: P8: the dynamics section of a track or bus; every stage optional

AudioDenoise.description: P8: a denoiser - kind fft, strength [0, 1]

AudioLeveler.description: P8: a leveler - kind speech or dynamic, target dBFS [-40, 0]

AudioBus.description: P8: a submix bus - fader, pan, EQ, dynamics, denoise, leveler, and an optional output bus (never a cycle, depth at most 4)
